none.description:
{Rune of Battle Rage}

Places the Rune of Battle Rage upon an allied unit, granting them the ability to strike all adjacent enemies in melee combat until their next attack.

basic.description:
{Basic Rune of Battle Rage}

Places the Rune of Battle Rage upon an allied unit, granting them the ability to strike all adjacent enemies in melee combat until their next attack.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Rune of Battle Rage}

Places the Rune of Battle Rage upon an allied unit and any allied units adjacent to the target, granting them the ability to strike all adjacent enemies in melee combat until their next attack.

expert.description:
{Expert Rune of Battle Rage}

Places the Rune of Battle Rage upon an allied unit and any allied units within 2 hexes of the target, granting them the ability to strike all adjacent enemies in melee combat without suffering retaliation until their next attack.
